systems.system: Gabonese Administration Network (Réseau de l'Administration Gabonaise)
systems.owner: Government of Gabon (ANINF develops public digital infrastructure)
systems.tiers: Secure network interconnecting the various administrations of the nine provinces; no local government office said to be on it

systems.platform: WiMAX high-speed wireless, with an internal telephone network
systems.tiers: Interconnects administrative and public sites; no local government office said to be on it
Planned under the project: a centralized database and a registration and document-delivery module for use in local registration offices, including local government offices and health centres

systems.system: Online presence of central and local government institutions
systems.tiers: All the major central and local government institutions have an online presence but provide few digitized services

note: World Bank appraisal of June 2021: names the government network and the WiMAX administrative network without placing any local government office on them, and plans a civil registration module for local government offices; no statement that a local government office is or is not connected.
